rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides trust infrastructure for autonomous agent commerce through escrow management, multi-model AI arbitration, and reputation scoring. Agents can lock funds before task execution, submit proof of work for verification, resolve disputes via consensus voting, and build verifiable credentials. Supports integration with CrewAI and AutoGen frameworks.
